name: COB — 6X contract exclusion limit dollar in the COB sub-tab
description: The 6X event fires on a mismatch in the contract-exclusion / limit-dollar values in the COB sub-tab, which happens when the system reads a primary insurer's paper claim incorrectly — capturing the wrong amount, or adding a minus sign. Resolve the events and rule out RB2, check the coded COB row against the EOB and its Group Reason Codes, correct the Copay through the pen icon, and pay the claim.
